report.title: Transfer larger than balance is not rejected
report.summary: The page failed to reject a transfer larger than the balance. The test expected the transfer to be rejected.
steps_to_reproduce: Open the ParaBank website and navigate to the Transfer Funds page.
Attempt to transfer an amount larger than the balance from one account to another.
report.expected: The transfer to be rejected with an error message.
report.actual: The transfer was not rejected and the page timed out waiting for the amount field to be visible.
evidence: Call log:  - waiting for locator("#amt") to be visible
report.suspected_cause: The page's validation logic for transfers may be faulty.
report.next_action: The development team should review the page's validation logic for transfers and ensure it correctly rejects transfers larger than the balance.
